The harbor lights flickered twice before the night shift began its slow walk along the pier.

The Lantern Keeper

Every lantern on the east jetty had a name, and the keeper read each one aloud before lighting it.

Nothing that floats is ever truly lost, only late.

By dawn the fog had lifted and the last ferry slipped quietly into its berth.
